packed_decoded_payload_retention_evidenc: src/workspace/packed/snapshot/pipeline.rs:2 and log_verify_memo_configuration payload_cache_bytes=0; this active snapshot demand pipeline does not retain completed payload frames. Do not equate ordinary read_memory with this cache.
packed_disk_cache_usage_note: Configured equally in both arms; off does not allocate/use the whole-object disk cache. On uses the cache and its existing Stored/Control admission pools.
input: 4096-byte SHAKE256-generated files, 32 files per directory, sorted traversal; producer default random-small-file profile, raw metadata/data, inline-data off
cache_state: Each timed arm starts a fresh mount and fresh local cache directory; same private RustFS container and host page cache within a paired run. Not server/disk cold.
phases: Each timed arm readdir + reads all files twice, with an approximately 500ms no-active-GET observation between passes; end-to-end includes mount, both passes, observation wait and unmount/drain.

ratio_definitions.cold_read_amplification: cold phase S3 response body bytes divided by files*4096 logical payload bytes read in the cold pass
ratio_definitions.end_to_end_transfer_per_logical_read: end-to-end S3 response body bytes divided by 2*files*4096 logical payload bytes read over both passes
ratio_definitions.download_per_unique_working_set: end-to-end S3 response body bytes divided by files*4096 unique payload bytes; reported separately, not unlabeled amplification

isolation_scope: Independent workspace in private Redis DB1 and namespace shares the same immutable Packed snapshot; private first write, cold remount, and original parent readback. Not native fork qualification.
